body:
Bumps [@aws-sdk/client-s3](https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-js-v3/tree/HEAD/clients/client-s3) from 3.1152.0 to 3.1156.0.
Release notes

Sourced from @​aws-sdk/client-s3's releases.

v3.1156.0

3.1156.0(2026-10-22)

Documentation Changes
  • client-lambda: AWS Lambda durable functions now supports payloads up to 1 MB for checkpoints, callback completion, and error details. (cdd6c609)
New Features
  • clients: update client endpoints as of 2026-10-22 (e5cd1562)
  • client-opensearchserverless: Adds APIs to create, get, list, and cancel ingestion jobs, and to create, get, list, and delete ingestion streams, for ingesting data from Amazon S3 into OpenSearch Serverless collections. (7712bce0)
  • client-continuum: Releasing Continuum for Code Vulnerabilities APIs for SDKs (0cbbd64c)
  • client-connect: Adds support for customer queryable replication errors. (4507ef01)
  • client-ec2: AWS Transit Gateway now provides managed one-to-one NAT directly on its attachments, through integration with Regional Private NAT Gateway. Use ModifyTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration to enable NAT and configure NAT rules, and GetTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration to view them. (68bea2ce)
  • client-bedrock-agentcore: Adds the dimension name to evaluation results and batch evaluation summaries. For multi-dimensional LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators, each result and summary now identifies which dimension it corresponds to. (185f264b)
  • client-networkmanager: AWS Cloud WAN now provides managed one-to-one NAT directly on it's core network attachments, through integration with Regional Private NAT Gateway. Use UpdateAttachmentNatConfiguration to enable NAT and configure NAT rules, and ListAttachmentNatConfigurations to view them. (944335d4)
  • client-bedrock-agentcore-control: Adds model-based routing and fallback to AgentCore Gateway rules. Rules can match the requested model, route to a specific model, and fall back across inference targets with an optional circuit breaker. Adds multi-dimensional rating scales for AgentCore Evaluations LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators. (9c2b09c2)
  • client-elementalinference: Elemental Inference now supports feed scheduling, letting you apply feed configuration changes at a time you choose instead of building your own automation. (b4108829)
  • client-glue: Add support for large worker types in AWS Glue (89ac4073)
  • client-kafkaconnect: Amazon MSK Connect now supports pausing and resuming connectors via the asynchronous PauseConnector and ResumeConnector APIs. Paused connectors keep their configuration and committed offsets and resume where they left off. Each call returns an operation ARN to track with DescribeConnectorOperation. (f5a4343a)
  • client-ivs-realtime: Adds RevokeConnectionToken operation for Amazon IVS Real-Time Streaming. (7c85a26a)

For list of updated packages, view updated-packages.md in assets-3.1156.0.zip

v3.1155.0

3.1155.0(2026-10-21)

Chores
  • temporarily disconnect from eclipse for Java formatting (#8375) (6d14aac7)
  • codegen: sync for JSON string serializer buffer fix and retryMode docs link (#8373) (5f53137d)
  • finspace: Remove finspace and finspace-data clients following the service shutdown (#8369) (48e34c48)
  • tnb: Remove tnb clients following shutdown (#8370) (e37bf8c2)
New Features
  • client-quicksight: Adds support for SharePoint and OneDrive two-legged OAuth certificate credentials and Google Workspace service account credentials when creating data sources (d0d47ac9)
  • client-sfn: Release minor updates to API model (6bb8593f)
  • client-network-firewall: Adds support for Network Firewall Resolved IP validation. (6a634360)
  • client-datazone: Added custom designations support with new CRUD APIs. The designation field in project membership and policy grant APIs supports a new enum for custom designations. These APIs also support a new field for custom designation id. (10021565)
  • client-ec2: Adds new response fields to DescribeInstanceStatus and Network Insights analysis results. (8e379695)
  • client-lightsail: This release adds support for metrics related to system-disk performance. (d21dd9d9)
  • client-healthlake: Update the UpdateProfileWithAgent API to return a streaming response to provide more frequent updates on what the agent is doing. (c2730b30)
  • client-polly: Added support for the new voices - Kenneth (en-US), Nate (en-US), Tina (de-DE), Carlos (es-US), Carolina (pt-BR), Leo (pt-BR), Curtis (en-AU), Kiara (en-IN), Arjun (en-IN) and Hyunduk (ko-KR). They are available as a Generative voices only. (4494f473)
  • client-connect: Added support for AWS-managed security profiles. (04f0c0b5)
  • client-auto-scaling: EC2 Auto Scaling now supports account settings, letting you manage account-level configuration for Auto Scaling. (d0cdb396)
  • client-lex-models-v2: Adds support for Assisted NLU - Dialog Manager mode allowing usage of LLMs as the default NLU system and dialog management (671f2125)

... (truncated)
